==================
Header comments and one commit
==================
# git-reword: edit the indented messages.
# Do not edit `commit` lines.

commit 7dcfdad1afb39b697a8632f0c450c555abe7d5b6
    Subject line

    Body line one.
    Body line two.

---

(document
  (comment)
  (comment)
  (blank_line)
  (commit
    (commit_line (sha (short_sha)))
    (message
      (subject (subject_text))
      (blank_line)
      (message_line (text))
      (message_line (text)))))

==================
Comment and info lines under the header
==================
commit 7dcfdad1afb39b697a8632f0c450c555abe7d5b6
# https://gitlab.com/g/r/-/commit/7dcfdad1afb39b697a8632f0c450c555abe7d5b6
Author: Ole <ole@example.com>
Date:   2026-02-25 05:59:29 +0100
committer: shares a prefix with the commit keyword
    Subject

---

(document
  (commit
    (commit_line (sha (short_sha)))
    (comment)
    (info_line (info_key) (info_value))
    (info_line (info_key) (info_value))
    (info_line (info_key) (info_value))
    (message
      (subject (subject_text)))))

==================

    # not a comment
        code block
# a real comment between message lines
    Key: value
